title: Biological effect of collagen scaffolds on rabbit’s socket healing
authors: Hafez K, Koura A, Kawana K, ElKazzaz N. Alexandria Dental Journal. 2023 Aug 48(2):66-72. 10.21608/adjalexu.2022.144565.1288. * collacone®
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “According to the findings of this study, collagen plugs used post -extraction in rabbits increased bone formation when compared to sockets without plugs placed” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
